body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_{d,\epsilon}\), the causal law \(G_P\) is identified by the observed table as \(G_P=\sum_{x:s(q_x)>0}s(q_x)\delta_{q_{11,x}/s_1(q_x)-q_{01,x}/s_0(q_x)}\), and every table with \(q_x\in\mathcal C_\epsilon\) and \(\sum_xs(q_x)=1\) admits a full-data completion in \(\mathcal M_{d,\epsilon}\).
body.justification: This reduction makes lower bounds on observed multinomial tables valid causal lower bounds on the unchanged target.
body.gap: ZengBalakrishnanHanKennedy2024 identifies only scalar means on the same table, while the present functional retains the entire mass-weighted effect law.
body.consumer: The reduction lets categorical-profile analyses compute and audit the target directly from observed arm--outcome cells.
